readerCopy.headline: The long plan may make more sense from here.
readerCopy.body:
A decision that felt boxed in may have more options now. You may see how one choice connects to a larger plan, or realize that a delay gave you information you did not have before. The future can feel less cramped without requiring a dramatic change today.

Jupiter trine Jupiter gives you room to think further ahead. Use the easier conditions to reorganize, learn, plan, or make the next move instead of spending the whole window enjoying the relief. The calm is useful because it lets you see farther.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a major windfall, travel, or that all plans made now will last.
